verdict.rationale: Configurable cloud environments are a fair axis for a coding agent, but the evidence shows no Gemini CLI feature for defining a reproducible cloud environment with repository dependencies and setup steps. Cloud Shell availability is a host-platform convenience, not a configurable per-repo environment. GEMINI.md context files only tailor agent behavior, so they are adjacent rather than environment provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
